title: DProvenanceKit VerificationInvariant
description: Machine-readable verification requirements shared by VerificationReceipt projection consumers (runtime, CaseClarity UI, CI Action, golden fixtures). JSON Schema validates the invariant document's shape only; evaluating whether a receipt's steps satisfy required_steps / must_include / ordering is the job of the VerificationInvariant evaluator — not of this schema.

id.description: Stable invariant identifier referenced by VerificationReceipt.invariant_id.

required_steps.description: Step types that must all appear in the projected receipt steps list.

must_include.description: Step types that are load-bearing for Verified status (typically includes verify).

ordering.description: Partial order constraints: each pair requires before to appear before after in the steps sequence.
